db:select.db:sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_products, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price > 100) AS over_100, min(price) AS price_min, max(price) AS price_max, round(avg(price), 4) AS price_avg, round(avg(data_gb), 4) AS data_avg_gb, count(data_gb) AS numeric_data_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_unlimited) AS unlimited_count, count(DISTINCT provider_id) AS provider_count, count(DISTINCT country_code) AS country_count, CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT currency) = 1 THEN max(currency) END AS currency FROM esim_products

SELECT pr.name AS provider, count(*) AS product_count, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_percent, round(avg(p.price), 2) AS price_avg, min(p.price) AS price_min, max(p.price) AS price_max, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_unlimited) AS unlimited_count FROM esim_products p JOIN providers pr ON pr.id = p.provider_id GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, pr.name

WITH b (ord, label, lo, hi) AS ( VALUES (1, '0 – 10 €', 0, 10), (2, '10 – 20 €', 10, 20), (3, '20 – 30 €', 20, 30), (4, '30 – 50 €', 30, 50), (5, '50 – 75 €', 50, 75), (6, '75 – 100 €', 75, 100), (7, '> 100 €', 100, NULL) ) SELECT b.label, b.lo AS min, b.hi AS max, count(p.id) AS count FROM b LEFT JOIN esim_products p ON p.price > b.lo - CASE WHEN b.ord = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AND (b.hi IS NULL OR p.price <= b.hi) GROUP BY b.ord, b.label, b.lo, b.hi ORDER BY b.ord
SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT currency) = 1 THEN max(currency) END AS currency FROM esim_products

SELECT CASE WHEN is_unlimited THEN 'Illimité' ELSE CAST(trim_scale(data_gb) AS text) || ' Go' END AS label, data_gb, is_unlimited, count(*) AS count FROM esim_products GROUP BY is_unlimited, data_gb ORDER BY is_unlimited, data_gb
SELECT validity_days || ' jours' AS label, count(*) AS count FROM esim_products GROUP BY validity_days ORDER BY validity_days
SELECT network AS label, count(*) AS count FROM esim_products GROUP BY network ORDER BY network

set-payload.value: #[output application/json import dw::Responses --- Responses::products(payload, vars.page, vars.pageSize, vars.totalItems as Number)]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT r.batch_id, r.source_file, r.trigger_type, r.status, r.rows_read, r.rows_inserted, r.rows_updated, r.rows_rejected, r.error_message, (to_jsonb(r.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') #>> '{}') || 'Z' AS started_at, (to_jsonb(r.finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') #>> '{}') || 'Z' AS finished_at FROM import_runs r WHERE r.batch_id = (SELECT batch_id FROM import_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.started_at, r.id
